from collections import Counter
from contextlib import redirect_stdout,redirect_stderr
import ast,hashlib,io,json,pathlib,subprocess,pytest
base='52d479d0f74fe4feb3c10b9501833d156b4c8cb6'
paths=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard','--','tests']).decode().splitlines()
assert len(paths)==11,paths
counter={}
class Counts:
 def pytest_collection_finish(self,session):counter.update(Counter(item.nodeid.split('::',1)[0] for item in session.items))
output=io.StringIO()
with redirect_stdout(output),redirect_stderr(output):
 result=pytest.main(['--collect-only','-q','-p','no:cacheprovider',*paths],plugins=[Counts()])
assert result==0,output.getvalue()
records=[]
for path in paths:
 raw=pathlib.Path(path).read_bytes();records.append({'path':path,'cases':counter[path],'literal_asserts':sum(isinstance(n,ast.Assert) for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(raw))),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()})
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only',base,'--','tests'])==b''
print(json.dumps({'files':records,'total_files':len(records),'total_cases':sum(counter.values()),'total_literal_asserts':sum(r['literal_asserts'] for r in records),'old_tracked_tests_changed':0,'collection_output_sha256':hashlib.sha256(output.getvalue().encode()).hexdigest()},sort_keys=True))
